result:
The Dashboard test phase (test-phase-06, US5) passed all 13 checks. No bugs were filed and the browser console showed no errors.

- **API (6 checks, curl):**
  - An empty database gives zeros and 0%.
  - Due today, overdue and completed today list exactly the right tasks. Archived, deleted, done and future tasks are left out.
  - Task completion is 25% (2 of 8 tasks), then 50% (4 of 8) after completing two more.
  - Habits: only active habits are listed, and the counts follow complete and undo.
  - Learning: the per-status counts and milestones match the data, including after a card is deleted.
  - Plans: only in-progress plans are listed, by priority, and their time left goes down. Ticking an item changes the Dashboard on the next read.
- **UI (7 checks, Playwright, headless):**
  - Every number and list on the page matched the API read at the same moment.
  - The plan time left counted down and still matched the API.
  - An item ticked on the plans page showed on the next Dashboard view.
  - The four quick-add buttons open the matching add forms.
  - All 36 navigation moves (6 pages × 6 links) reach the right page with the right heading.

Three things I recorded in the report but didn't file as bugs, because no requirement covers them:
- The Learning summary card leaves out the Not Started count. That count is still shown in the learning snapshot section.
- One plan shows a "Started" badge even though it started before the page was opened. It's probably old browser data left over from an earlier test database, as seen in the phase-08 run.
- Playwright's `check()` reported that one plan checkbox didn't change, but the checkbox ended up checked and the API saved it. This is the same quirk seen in test-phase-04.

The phase is marked `done` in `suite.json`, its checklist is ticked, and the log line is added to `progress.md`. The report is at `loops/testing/outputs/001-quickflow/suite/test-phase-06-report.md`. The suite is still `running`: test-phase-07, E2E and regression are left.
